title: One Fungus Hit 501 Amphibian Species Worldwide
hook: This fungus did not just kill frogs; it erased entire species.
closing: The fungus erased species, and many survivors are still declining.
question: Which frog would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus affected 501 amphibian species, creating a worldwide survival crisis.
Thirty-nine percent of affected species are still declining, so the damage has not stopped.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species, carrying the global crisis into one country's ecosystems.
